subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers require inspectable Google Chat app-auth delivery proof for this external PR, or explicitly waive the live-proof gate after the code defects are repaired?
rationale: The PR body has source-level tests and narrative production confirmation, but no inspectable after-fix artifact; only maintainers can waive that external real-behavior proof gate for Google Chat credentials they may not be able to provide publicly.

options.title: Require proof and repair
options.body: Ask for redacted app-auth logs, terminal/live output, screenshot, recording, or linked artifact after narrowing the predicate and preserving metadata.

options.title: Waive live proof after repair
options.body: Maintainers can accept source/API-contract proof for the live branch, but should make the proof waiver explicit after the blocking code defects are fixed.

options.title: Use sibling canonical PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 is chosen instead, pause or close this branch after that candidate is refreshed and merge-ready.

recommendation.title: Require proof and repair
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted app-auth logs, terminal/live output, screenshot, recording, or linked artifact after narrowing the predicate and preserving metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat API/media/action history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the proof and canonical-branch choice.
